source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 18ης Ιουλίου — «Άγιοι Δάσιος και Μάρων»

attestations.note: The life page /2150/ heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 18 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and gives the pair one sentence: they were martyred by the sword. He is not the corpus's `maron-the-hermit`, whose Greek and Romanian rows both stand on 14 Φεβρουαρίου and who is a hermit and wonderworker dated before the fifth century, not a martyr by the sword on this day. The page's etymology box for the name remarks that a Μάρων was a priest from Thrace, the son of Euanthes who gave wine to Odysseus; that is the site's note on the name out of Homer and not a statement about this saint, and nothing of it is recorded here as his. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on this page; the day's «Άγιος Ιωάννης Θ' Πατριάρχης Κωνσταντινούπολης *» does carry it and is refused. No year, no place and no judge is printed, so there is no `dates` object and no `locations`, and the page prints no hymn.
